operations.details: Verified official HMLR Practice Guide 40 overview.
Plan-guidance framework separated from direct terrain measurement.
Boundary/title-plan supplements retained as interpretation contracts, not survey outputs.
Plan framework not promoted to centimetre-level geometry.
Historical deed/document copy retained as documentary evidence.
Document date not silently treated as current terrain survey epoch.
Deed plan or description not promoted to direct elevation observation.
Increment 198 PG40 overview and deeds guidance retained as distinct contracts.
No plan-framework or deed value substituted for terrain measurement.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
